prompt:
Design an expressive iOS/macOS Music widget for a desktop dashboard. Generate 5 distinct compositions in Small (160x160), Medium (340x160) and Large (340x340). One layout per size, rendered once. Never repeat a row or value.

Compositions (distinct surfaces, palettes & motion):
1 Synced Lyrics: White (#FFFFFF) card; top-left rounded cover art with green app badge; top-right 3-line scrolling lyrics (active bold black, others grey); bottom divider, black pause circle, "3:12 / 5:49".
2 Obsidian Vinyl: Pitch black (#141414) card with slow album-aura glow; cover art with overlapping bottom-right artist avatar, top-right source icon, bold white title/artist.
3 Bento Audio: White shell with top track header + animated equalizer; bottom grey (#F2F2F7) sub-cards with mini cover and teal audio spectrum bars.
4 Full-Bleed Scrim: Edge-to-edge cover art with slow drift and dark scrim, white track header, bright yellow elapsed time hero bottom-left, white pill bar right.
5 Terracotta Groove: Warm terracotta (#E07A5F) card with spinning circular vinyl top-left, cream track labels, and huge white time hero.

Hard content limits per size:
Small: cover art, title, artist, plus ONE item (play badge or corner avatar). Max 4 items. No lyrics, bar, or queue.
Medium: Small's content plus ONE block: 3-line scrolling lyrics + transport bar, OR pill progress bar + timestamps.
Large: Medium's content plus ONE more block: 3-track up-next queue in a grey sub-card. Include a quiet "Nothing playing" state.
Never squeeze larger content into a smaller size.

Spacing & Visual: 24px squircle; padding 16px Small, 20px Medium/Large; 8px grid, 12px+ group gaps, no clipping. One clear hero per size, other text 11-14px (never <11px). Believable data.
designSpec: A composition picker reveals five distinct directions, each rendering exactly one Small, Medium and Large tile with unique track data. Fixed dimensions, 24px corners and size-specific content budgets preserve the dashboard proportions; Large alone adds a three-track queue and an alternative idle state. Motion is represented statically, and transport controls explicitly operate only the local visual preview.
stages: Searching for real image URLs from 5 queries
Fitting the data into the widget
